text:
miguel: Morning folks, first day! Trying to build the inference runtime on my workstation (Pop!_OS 22.04) which has an RTX 3090 and an external 4090 eGPU. Running `./scripts/build.sh --cuda` and hit a ptxas error. Anyone seen multi-GPU arch issues? @lina

lina: welcome! :wave: Can you paste `nvcc --version`, `nvidia-smi`, and the ptxas snippet? Multi-target builds can confuse older nvcc/cmake combos.

miguel: nvcc:
```
nvcc: NVIDIA (R) Cuda compiler driver
Cuda compilation tools, release 11.6, V11.6.124
```

nvidia-smi (host):
```
GPU 0: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090
Driver Version: 525.60
```

nvidia-smi (eGPU):
```
GPU 1: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
Driver Version: 525.60
```

ptxas snippet:
```
[ 22%] Building CUDA object src/runtime/CMakeFiles/runtime_cuda.dir/batched_kernels.cu.o
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: Unknown gpu architecture 'compute_89'
CMake Error at cmake/FindCUDA.cmake:1455 (message):
  ptxas died with status 1
```

lina: looks like CMake tried to compile for both 86 and 89 via the default generator. nvcc 11.6 doesn't know compute_89 (4090/Lovelace). Two practical fixes: upgrade your toolkit to 12.x (recommended for 4090), or override the cmake arch flags to use integer archs.

paige: for multi-GPU dev boxes we usually recommend building for the lowest common denom or using docker. Example quick fix (local):
```
export CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="86"
rm -rf build && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build -j
```
That keeps the binary targeted at the 3090 but runs on the eGPU too. If you need both in one binary, use the dev image with CUDA 12.2 and set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86;89` inside container.

infra-bot: Recommended dev image: redwood/dev:cuda-12-2025 (CUDA 12.2, tested for 4090). Using container avoids host toolkit/driver skew.

miguel: Tried setting `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86` and cleaned build — got past ptxas but hit a cudnn ABI mismatch (system cuDNN older). Switched to docker image and rebuilt inside container with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86;89` and it completed.

miguel: Build success! :tada: I'll open a small PR for docs/dev-setup.md describing the two paths: 1) single-arch local build (set CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES to lower arch) or 2) multi-arch container build (use redwood/dev:cuda-12 and set arch list). Will include the nvcc/nvidia-smi outputs and the ptxas snippet.

paige: awesome, please tag `chore(dev): docs multi-gpu arch guidance` and ping dev-experience. Also add a one-liner to the onboarding checklist about preferring the docker image for multi-GPU laptops.

devex-bot: Suggestion: add a note in cmake/Arch.cmake to warn when CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES includes an arch not supported by the detected nvcc and point to docs.

miguel: Will do — thanks for the quick help, everyone!
